item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We refuse to accept that future. Preventing it must come before racing to build it.

2. We reject the rush toward superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We demand prevention, accountability, and human lives before technological ambition.

3. We will not call mass death the price of progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must act before that danger becomes a reality.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We refuse to treat those deaths as an acceptable cost of innovation. We reject a race that puts technological ambition ahead of human life, and we demand action before this future becomes reality. We need enforceable limits, public accountability, and the political will to put prevention first. We will keep organizing, speaking out, and challenging every claim that building more powerful systems matters more than protecting people. We owe each other more than a future shaped by preventable catastrophe.
